nom: Cosmetic Grade Pumice - 100% Pure Natural Grain/Powder - Great for Skin Exfoliation in DIY Soaps

aspects.libelle: Very fine, consistent grain that mixes smoothly
Settles out of suspension in liquid mixes
Economical way to make your own scrub
Coarser grades are too abrasive for the face
Well packaged, arrives without rips or tears

extraits.texte: This pumice is excellent! I don’t know why I didn’t think of buying this years ago! I have been wasting money on pre-made facial scrubs that don’t work as the scrub particles are too big, not enough of them, or dissolve while using. I found 1 product that had the perfect type of scrub granules, I now know it was pumice, but the company stopped making it! Frustrating as heck, to say the least. I then decided to see if I could just buy the finely ground pumice to add to my favorite face wash. Here It Is! This finely ground pumice is absolutely PERFECT! My facial skin is as soft as warm silk! Enormous difference! This is even better than the scrub I used to like! I will NEVER buy a pre-made facial scrub again! Buying the fine pumice and adding it to whatever face wash product you love is most definitely the way to go! This is so economical as well! I just put a tiny amount of the pumice in the palm of my hand, add a small amount of my facial cleanser, mix it with a little water in the palm of my hand, apply it to my face, and with “very light pressure” in a circular motion, wash my face! So simple, and it works so well! I am saving so much money! This works best with a creamier cleanser, but I also use it with a gel cleanser a few times per week. I just use a little less pumice with the gel cleanser.
Exactly as described. Medium is good for a face/body scrub. Does settle out of suspension in whatever you mix it into. Coarse would be very scratchy for anything other that feet and hands.

extraits.titre: Excellent exfoliant naturel, parfait pour la fabrication de savons maison
extraits.texte: Je cherchais une solution naturelle pour ajouter un effet exfoliant à mes savons Melt & Pour, et cette poudre de pierre ponce est tout simplement parfaite. La texture est fine, homogène et facile à doser. Elle se mélange très bien à la base fondue, sans créer de grumeaux ni retomber au fond lorsqu’on l’incorpore doucement. Je l’utilise dans mes savons artisanaux faits maison (avec base karité ou argan), et le résultat est exactement ce que je recherchais : un exfoliant doux mais efficace, qui laisse la peau plus lisse sans l’irriter. Idéal pour les zones rugueuses comme les coudes, talons ou jambes. Le fait qu’elle soit 100 % naturelle, sans additifs ni parfum, est un vrai plus pour les peaux sensibles ou réactives. Je l’ai aussi testée en masque visage (en très petite quantité mélangée à de l’argile), et la sensation de peau nettoyée en profondeur est bien présente. Un incontournable si vous fabriquez vos cosmétiques maison ou que vous cherchez une alternative naturelle aux microbilles synthétiques. J’en recommanderai sans hésiter.

This product is not only affordable, but is amazing at exfoliating the skin. After one use of mixing it with my cleanser my skin feels so soft and clean. I will definitely repurchase this in the future, it’s my new go to product when my skin is in need of a good exfoliation.
Great for your skin. It feels amazing after using this. Such a cheap and easy way to replace microdermabrasion
Great product. I always mix some with my body wash. Great product.

reserve: This is a raw DIY ingredient bought mostly for soap-making and crafting rather than direct skincare use, so reviews rarely describe a specific skin type or concern the way finished skincare products do.
